use_cases: Expanding a button or trigger element into a full dialog with smooth morphing animation
Creating confirmation dialogs that feel cohesive with their trigger actions
Building nested modal flows with animated transitions between states
Implementing accessible dialog patterns with keyboard navigation support
Replacing traditional modals with more fluid, motion-rich alternatives
ai_summary: A morphing dialog component from the motion-primitives library that animates from a trigger element into a full dialog overlay. Uses React Context for state management and Framer Motion for smooth transitions. Ideal for creating premium-feeling modal experiences with seamless morph animations between trigger and dialog states.
